Subject: Request to open role and launch interview gate — Senior Inference Engineer

Hi Vivek + Karthik,

We need approval to open a replacement slot for a Senior Inference Engineer on the serving/runtime team. This is a backfill for the capacity slot that came open after Alex left — role is critical for Q3 optimizations. Key asks:

- Greenlight hiring gate so recruiting can begin outreach
- Confirm the interview panel (I propose Karthik, Vivek, and one systems engineer)
- Agree to target on-site/virtual loop the week of 3/29 or 4/5

I've attached the latest JD and a very short shortlist of two internal referrals and one external sourced candidate (sheet). If we get the greenlight today, Soojin can kick off scheduling and Onyx can prioritize outreach.

Attachments: JD_Senior_Inference_Engineer.pdf, candidate_shortlist.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request to open role and launch interview gate — Senior Inference Engineer

Marissa — thanks for the context and materials. I approve opening the headcount and starting the hiring gate today with two conditions:

1) Keep the first loop to a 90-minute panel (technical + systems) vs separate half-days to reduce candidate friction.
2) If we run into scheduling issues, use the fallback panel (two engineers + one product) listed in the panel doc.

Cc'ing Soojin and Irene to own scheduling and compliance for interviews (background checks/KBA). Karthik — please confirm you can join the panel the week of 3/29; if not, state your availability and we will use the fallback.

Vivek
VP, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
